dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Go ahead! I take your bullets! You think you kill me with bullets? I take your bullets! Go ahead!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's Jeht. It's like... she's gone mad with fury...

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: You scum! Come back! I'll rip out your livers. I'll grill you alive. I will chomp on your bones!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Does she even know what she's saying?

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Capture me alive? Capture me alive, will you? Oh, you'll capture me alright — once I've bled my last drop of blood on these sands! Come on!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey... There wouldn't be anyone alive to capture in that case...
